Furthermore, almost all ticket acceptance criteria are missing: dynamic schema WeakMap caching, the `execute` one-line doc comment, the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`. The candidate also leaves an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file in the repository and prematurely creates a `0.4.0` release header in `CHANGELOG.md` instead of adding a complete entry under `[Unreleased]`.
